preparation_rules: Do not cook: Exposure to heat turns fronds soft, slimy, and watery.
Clean thoroughly: Trim fibrous roots and submerge in clean water to remove grit.
Dress immediately prior to eating: Acid and salt wilt feather-like leaves quickly.

recipes.title: Caribbean-Style Fresh Feather Seaweed Salad
recipes.description: A cold, crisp salad tossing fresh Caulerpa sertularioides with lime juice, bell pepper, and garlic.
ingredients: 200 g fresh Caulerpa sertularioides (trimmed and washed)
1 small garlic clove (grated or finely minced)
1 small scotch bonnet or habanero chili (seeded and minced, optional)
instructions: Rinse the feather seaweed fronds in cold water twice to remove sand. Trim off yellowed stems or holdfasts. Drain in a colander and gently pat dry with paper towels.
In a serving bowl, combine the lime juice, olive oil, minced garlic, sea salt, black pepper, and optional scotch bonnet chili.
Add the diced red bell pepper and red onion to the dressing.
Gently add the Caulerpa sertularioides fronds to the bowl, toss softly to coat, and serve immediately.

filipino.title: Sariwang Feather Seaweed Salad, Estilong Caribbean
filipino.description: Malamig at malutong na salad ng sariwang Caulerpa sertularioides na hinaluan ng katas ng kalamansi, siling kampana, at bawang.
ingredients: 200 g sariwang Caulerpa sertularioides (pinutulan at hinugasan)
1 maliit na pulang siling kampana (tinadtad nang pino)
1 maliit na butil ng bawang (kinayod o tinadtad nang pino)
1 tbsp extra virgin na langis ng oliba
1/2 tsp bagong-giling na itim na paminta
1 maliit na scotch bonnet o habanero na sili (inalisan ng buto at tinadtad, opsyonal)
instructions: Banlawan nang dalawang ulit sa malamig na tubig ang mga dahon ng feather seaweed upang maalis ang buhangin. Putulin ang mga nanilaw na tangkay o kapit-ugat. Patuluin sa salaan at dahan-dahang patuyuin gamit ang paper towel.
Sa mangkok na paghahainan, pagsamahin ang katas ng kalamansi, langis ng oliba, tinadtad na bawang, asin-dagat, itim na paminta, at opsyonal na scotch bonnet na sili.
Idagdag sa sawsawan ang tinadtad na pulang siling kampana at pulang sibuyas.
Dahan-dahang idagdag sa mangkok ang mga dahon ng Caulerpa sertularioides, marahang haluin upang mabalutan, at ihain kaagad.

recipes.title: Southeast Asian Green Mango & Feather Seaweed Salad
recipes.description: A fresh salad pairing the natural peppery crunch of feather seaweed with sour green mango and coconut vinegar.
ingredients: 1/2 cup unripened green mango (peeled and julienned or shredded)
1 small shallot or red onion (thinly sliced)
2 tbsp coconut vinegar or cane vinegar
1 tbsp fresh calamansi or lime juice
instructions: Submerge Caulerpa sertularioides in clean, chilled water for 2 minutes to crisp the fronds. Drain thoroughly.
In a bowl, whisk together the vinegar, calamansi juice, sugar, and salt until dissolved.
Add the shredded green mango, diced tomatoes, and sliced shallots into the vinegar dressing.
Place the chilled seaweed fronds on a platter, spoon the green mango mixture over top right before serving, and toss gently.

filipino.title: Salad ng Hilaw na Manggang Berde at Feather Seaweed, Estilong Timog-Silangang Asya
filipino.description: Sariwang salad na pinagtatambal ang natural na maanghang at malutong na feather seaweed, maasim na manggang berde, at suka ng niyog.
ingredients: 1/2 cup hilaw na manggang berde (binalatan at hiniwang pahaba o ginayat)
2 maliit na hinog na kamatis (inalisan ng ubod at hiniwang pakuwadrado)
1 maliit na sibuyas na pula o pulang sibuyas (hiniwang maninipis)
2 tbsp suka ng niyog o suka ng tubo
1 tbsp sariwang katas ng kalamansi o dayap
instructions: Ilubog ang Caulerpa sertularioides sa malinis at pinalamig na tubig nang 2 minuto upang maging malutong ang mga dahon. Patuluin nang mabuti.
Sa mangkok, haluin ang suka, katas ng kalamansi, asukal, at asin hanggang matunaw.
Idagdag sa sawsawan ng suka ang ginayat na manggang berde, hiniwang kamatis, at hiniwang sibuyas.
Ilagay sa pinggan ang pinalamig na mga dahon ng seaweed, sandukan ng halo ng manggang berde bago ihain, at dahan-dahang haluin.

recipes.title: South Asian Spiced Coconut & Lime Feather Seaweed Salad
recipes.description: A raw side dish featuring feather seaweed tossed with freshly grated coconut, green chilies, and citrus.
ingredients: 1.5 tbsp fresh lemon or lime juice
instructions: Wash the seaweed fronds under cool running water and submerge in an ice bath for 3 minutes. Drain completely.
In a mortar or bowl, lightly bruise the green chilies, minced shallot, grated coconut, salt, and lime juice together.
Add the drained Caulerpa sertularioides to the mixture, folding gently so as not to bruise the fronds. Serve cold.

filipino.title: Maanghang na Niyog at Kalamansi na Feather Seaweed Salad, Estilong Timog Asya
filipino.description: Hilaw na ulam na may feather seaweed na hinaluan ng bagong-kayod na niyog, berdeng sili, at sitrus.
ingredients: 1 maliit na sibuyas na pula (tinadtad nang pino)
1.5 tbsp sariwang katas ng lemon o kalamansi
instructions: Hugasan ang mga dahon ng seaweed sa malamig na umaagos na tubig at ilubog sa tubig na may yelo nang 3 minuto. Patuluin nang lubusan.
Sa almires o mangkok, bahagyang dikdikin o durugin ang berdeng sili, tinadtad na sibuyas, kinayod na niyog, asin, at katas ng kalamansi.
Idagdag sa halo ang pinatulong Caulerpa sertularioides at marahang itupi upang hindi madurog ang mga dahon. Ihain nang malamig.
